canon_ref.note: Same day as the chess game. The Runner delivery is due the next day. Deltas are design values.

b1.erin_befriends_krshia.summary: Erin apologises to Krshia for snubbing her. The Gnoll laughs, hugs her and names herself a Silverfang. A truth stone backs Erin's claim about her chess skill. Krshia sells her soap, toothpaste and food at a discount, books a Runner delivery for tomorrow and shows her the bath house.

b1.erin_names_the_inn.news: The old inn on the hill has a name now: The Wandering Inn. A second sign asks people not to kill Goblins.

canon_ref.note: Evening of the chess day. The location name in data stays 'The abandoned inn on the hill'; the flag marks the new name.

b1.erin_names_the_inn.summary: At home, Erin decides she will not play life as a game with one winner. She runs back for tools and powdered paint, paints over the old sign and writes 'The Wandering Inn', and plants a second sign by the door: 'No Killing Goblins'. Pisces and the littlest Goblin read them.
